text:
Isabelle Tran: Heads-up: Candidate Noah Kim (Sr ML Engineer) got a competing offer. Hiring manager requests provisional band uplift and expedited start. Need approval routing and ETA.
Priya Kapoor: What uplift and sign-on amount are they asking for? :eyes:
Isabelle Tran: Manager wants provisional move from M5 -> M6 and a $10k sign-on (competing firm offered $15k). Candidate can start ~2 weeks earlier if we confirm.
Liam O'Connor: Payroll cutoff this Fri. If start is before next cycle we'll need manual payroll setup. @Finance Review please advise.
Finance Review: Manual payroll is doable but requires comp-committee and legal approvals, plus Workday entries: band=M6 (provisional), signon=10000, payroll_manual=true.
Priya Kapoor: Routing now to comp-committee and Legal. hr-ops-bot will log approvals. Setting 48h decision window since candidate is waiting.
hr-ops-bot: Request 3472223334 created. Approvals required: comp-committee, Legal Team, Finance Review. Deadline: 48h from request.
Isabelle Tran: Checklist posted to candidate file:
- Provisional band change form (M5->M6)
- Sign-on approval ($10k)
- Start date exception (early by 14 days)
- Workday update + manual payroll flag
Noah Kim: Thanks for the update. I prefer Redwood but need to confirm by EOD tomorrow if possible.
Liam O'Connor: If comp-committee OKs today and Legal signs off, we can lock manual payroll for start date 2026-04-20. Otherwise fallback to 2026-05-04.
Priya Kapoor: Comp-committee gave verbal OK; formal sign coming. Legal requested standard clawback clause for sign-on; drafting now.
Finance Review: Confirm manual payroll can be processed for 2026-04-20 if we get complete cost center and invoice code from the manager today.
Isabelle Tran: Manager provided cost center ENG-MLE and will DM invoice code by 3pm PST.
hr-ops-bot: Approval update: comp-committee=approved, Legal Team=pending, Finance Review=pending.
Priya Kapoor: If Legal signs before 5pm we'll proceed and inform candidate. If not, ask candidate if they can hold until 04/27.
Isabelle Tran: I'll keep candidate informed and share final offer wording once Legal returns the clause. Will update thread as soon as we have sign-off.
Liam O'Connor: Also tagging eng-ops to prep early onboarding laptop shipping if start moves up.
Isabelle Tran: Thanks everyone 64f (end of thread until approvals complete).
